name: Pahadi Dal
instructions: 1. Wash the Kali Masoor dal thoroughly and soak for 30 minutes.
2. Pressure cook the dal with water, salt, and turmeric until soft and well-cooked.
3. In a heavy-bottomed pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds and a pinch of asafoetida.
4. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
5. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute.
6. Add tomatoes and cook until they soften into a paste.
7. Add red chili powder and garam masala, mixing well with the base.
8. Pour the cooked dal into the tempering (tadka), mix well, and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
9. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with steamed rice or siddu.
description: Pahadi Dal is a staple comfort food in the mountainous regions of Himachal Pradesh. It is highly valued for its earthy flavor and nutritional density, often cooked in iron vessels or slow-cooked over a wood fire in rural households to provide warmth and energy in the cold Himalayan climate.
